parties.respondent_defendant: K.Vasantha, with children Uma Sangeeth, Uma Jyothi and Uma Shankar

facts_of_case: The original petition seeking declaration of marital status and paternity was decreed by the Family Court. The first respondent is in appeal. The parties are disputing over retirement benefits of late Ayyappan.

legal_principles.principle: An appeal is the continuation of the original proceeding.
legal_principles.held: An appeal is the continuation of the original proceeding.

legal_principles.principle: Acts done pending the appeal are subject to the outcome of the appeal.
legal_principles.held: Acts done pending the appeal are subject to the outcome of the appeal, lest it would be easy to defeat an appeal.

legal_principles.principle: A marriage solemnised during the one year period stipulated under the proviso is not void.
legal_principles.held: The Apex Court after detailed consideration of the relevant provisions of the HM Act held that violation of the proviso does not render the marriage void under the scheme of the Act.
cited_cases: Lila Gupta v. Laxmi Narain, (1978) 3 SCC 258

outcome.final_order: The original petition seeking declaration of marital status and paternity was decreed by the Family Court.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for dissolution of marriage
advising on property division in a divorce case
assisting with maintenance and custody disputes
